newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deka signs two fund cooperation agreements.
newsitem.headline: Deka signs two fund cooperation agreements.

text.p: Deka, the fund management wing of the German savings bank organisation, said on Tuesday it agreed to cooperate with J.P. Morgan of the U.S. and Lombard Odier & Cie of Switzerland in the fields of financial research, fund management and portfolio management.

J.P. Morgan will manage selected international savings bank investment funds, to be based in Dublin, from mid-1997, while the second agreement with Lombard Odier will offer building society customers investment funds-linked portfolio management services starting in the second half of this year.

Friedhelm Schaperjahn, management board chairman of DekaBank GmbH, the holding company of the Deka group, said that Deka has nearly 120 billion marks under management and administers more than one million accounts.
"If we wish to maintain our major share of the German market, we cannot rest on our laurels in the face of increasing competition for private banking customers," said Schaperjahn.
